reference.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE landscape character model reference sheet for an ORIGINAL recurring adult character named Juan for a Hebrew-language Spanish travel learning app. This is a production identity reference, not a learner screen. Design quality: beautiful premium stylized 3D story adventure illustration with tactile fabric and sculpted forms, natural adult proportions, subtle expressive faces and cinematic soft warm light; appealing to adult backpackers, sophisticated rather than toddler cartoon, not photorealistic and not a flat vector. Backdrop is clean warm ivory. Show the SAME EXACT man in three uncluttered separate views: a large face/shoulders three-quarter portrait, a front full-body standing view, and a side profile/three-quarter full-body view. These are three views of one identity, never three different people. Juan is an approachable 28-year-old fellow traveler, warm medium tan complexion, brown eyes, thick gently curved eyebrows, softly squared face, distinctive medium-length dark brown wavy hair swept back with one loose curl above his forehead, short neat dark beard and mustache. Clothes to lock across all views: plain terracotta overshirt with rolled sleeves over a cream crew-neck T-shirt, deep olive trousers, worn off-white walking sneakers, forest-green canvas backpack with ochre zipper pulls, a simple narrow ochre woven bracelet on his right wrist. Friendly relaxed small smile, warm curious eyes, relaxed adult posture. Clear clean silhouette, beautifully rendered warm materials, nuanced details visible at mobile size. Preserve facial structure, haircut, beard, skin tone, body proportions, outfit and backpack exactly across the three views. All hands anatomically coherent. No writing, no names, no lettering, no labels, no speech bubbles, no UI, no logos, no watermarks. Leave breathing room between the views and keep complete heads and feet in frame.

His outfit and identifying details must remain the same: terracotta rolled-sleeve overshirt open over a cream crew-neck T-shirt, olive trousers, forest-green canvas backpack with ochre zipper pulls, narrow ochre woven bracelet on his RIGHT wrist. Keep the same polished tactile cinematic character rendering as the reference, with expressive adult features. Scene: first morning in a welcoming South American travelers' hostel common room, warm morning sunlight entering an arched window, softly textured cream walls, natural wood, a few leafy plants, cozy sage-green accents. Juan is the ONLY visible person. From the learner's point of view, he has just noticed us and is greeting us with warm eye contact, a natural small smile and a relaxed open-palm wave, his backpack casually on his back. A believable friendly moment, not a posed studio portrait, not a classroom. Medium environmental portrait, waist or upper thighs upward, Juan visually prominent enough that his face stays recognizable in a small mobile illustration; beautiful depth and soft background detail. Landscape close to 5:4 composition intended to fill a 345x280 phone illustration slot. Keep Juan's complete head, visible waving hand, shoulders and backpack inside the CENTRAL 70% so a modest side crop will not cut them off. Soft morning golden light, rich but restrained terracotta/sage/cream color harmony. Render the scene to the edges; no border, no outer padding, no layout frame. No collage, no duplicated character, no additional people or human faces. No letters, no text, no labels, no numbers, no speech bubble, no Hola or lesson answer, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Natural coherent five-finger hands. The face and outfit must clearly match Image 1 rather than generating a different man.
